messages:
elyse: Kicking off a multi-sprint effort: "session-fence" 0 tighten boundaries around session state and extract minimal runtime tiles. Not a full strip, iterative tiles by capability. Sync tomorrow 10:30 PT?

noah: what problems are we explicitly solving with session-fence?

elyse: reduce accidental coupling (cross-service KV lookups), clarify ownership, enable per-tenant scaling, and shrink incident blast radius. Also make future dedicated/private deploys simpler.

priya: compatibility is key. SDKs and proxies shouldn't require simultaneous changes. propose an opt-in header: X-Session-Fence: v1 to opt a tenant into tiled handling.

jamal: major perf concern: token hotpath latency and batching. we should preserve a lightweight batching proxy in front of tiles initially while we iterate on placement.

noah: migration strategy: feature-flag + per-tenant placement API + warm caches. rollout by tenant cohorts grouped by traffic shape (low, med, high).

priya: tests to add: semantic regression suite (canonical prompts), migration chaos (kill tile mid-migration), and batch-size/queue-latency guards.

ci-bot: CI checklist: new branch session-fence, add canary pipelines, auto-tag artifacts with session-fence.

elyse: acceptance criteria suggestion: p95 latency delta <= 5% on hotpath, token-loop p99 <= 3% increase, rollback per-tenant within 5 minutes, and Console shows per-tenant cost delta during rollouts.

jamal: ops runbook items: preflight checklist, warm-up step, migration flow, rollback knobs, post-cutover validation. I'll draft the runbook and include emergency contacts.

noah: interface sketch (keep minimal):
{"path":"/v1/generate","tenant":"t-007","model":"redwood/llama-3x","input":"...","headers":{"X-Session-Fence":"v1"}}
Keep payload identical to avoid downstream churn.

priya: telemetry: keep events stable; add tag tile_id and placement_shard for attribution. no upstream schema changes.

elyse: owners: jamal (ops + runbook), priya (compat + tests), noah (batching + perf), elyse (RFC + diagrams). RFC draft by Thu EOD, prototype in next sprint.

ci-bot: scheduled: staging canary window next Tue 02:00 UTC. Ensure oncall assigned.

elyse: thanks all. I'll post the RFC link here and invite infra & SRE reviewers.
